verdict.rationale: Riveter publishes an OpenAPI spec at docs.riveterhq.com/openapi.yaml, which describes the API's capabilities, and its docs and Go SDK include copyable code examples (Enrich, Runs.List). The evidence never shows an interactive "try it" explorer or in-browser runnable requests, and the probes found no openapi.json or llms.txt at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it examples in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
